title: Finite quasi-coherent algebra module from a homogeneous action
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings and B an A-algebra. Let graded_m be A-submodules of B giving an internal direct sum decomposition indexed by natural numbers, with 1 in graded_0, graded_k * graded_l contained in graded_(k+l), and every algebraMap(a) in graded_0. Let X be a scheme, f : X → Spec(A), and G_m quasi-coherent O_X-modules. Suppose mu m k b : G_m → G_(m+k) is O_X-linear for b in graded_k, additive in b, satisfies mu m l b' followed by mu (m+l) k b = mu m (k+l) (b*b') after the degree associativity identification, and mu m 0 (algebraMap(a)) acts on sections by multiplication by the restriction of f-sharp(a). Suppose each point x has an open neighbourhood U, finitely many degrees d_i and sections s_i of G_(d_i)(U), such that every section t of G_m(V), V contained in U, is locally at each point of V in the O_X-span of mu (d_i) (m-d_i) b applied to the restriction of s_i, with d_i ≤ m and b in graded_(m-d_i), with the canonical degree identification. Set b = Spec(A → B), Y = X ×_Spec(A) Spec(B), and pi = Y → X. Then there exists a quasi-coherent finite-type module N over the sheaf of rings underlying C = pi_*O_Y, together with an O_X-linear isomorphism from the restriction of N along the structural morphism O_X -> C to the sheaf coproduct of the G_m. This step constructs an algebra module on X; it does not construct an O_Y-module or apply the inverse affine correspondence.

proof.text: The map Spec(B) to Spec(A) is affine and its base change pi is affine. Let R be the sectionwise algebra-valued pushforward, and set N = R.obj F. Clause (2) of affine_module_correspondence gives N.IsQuasicoherent. The reverse implication of affine_module_finite_type, with the identity algebra-linear isomorphism, gives N.IsFiniteType. Its scalar restriction is definitionally the ordinary scheme-module pushforward of F. Uniqueness of the coproduct identifies this scalar restriction with the coproduct of G.

theorem exists_finiteType_graded_algebra_module
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (graded : ℕ → Submodule A B)
    (hgrading : DirectSum.IsInternal graded)
    (hunit : (1 : B) ∈ graded 0)
    (hmul : ∀ (k l : ℕ) {x y : B}, x ∈ graded k → y ∈ graded l → x * y ∈ graded (k + l))
    (hscalar : ∀ (a : A), algebraMap A B a ∈ graded 0)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    (G : ℕ → X.Modules)
    (hG : ∀ m : ℕ, (G m).IsQuasicoherent)
    (mu : ∀ (m k : ℕ), graded k → (G m ⟶ G (m + k)))
    (hmu_add : ∀ (m k : ℕ) (b b' : graded k),
      mu m k (b + b') = mu m k b + mu m k b')
    (hmu_mul : ∀ (m k l : ℕ) (b : graded k) (b' : graded l),
      HEq (mu m l b' ≫ mu (m + l) k b)
        (mu m (k + l) ⟨b.val * b'.val, hmul k l b.property b'.property⟩))
    (hmu_scalar : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : A) (U : X.Opens)
      (t : (G m).val.obj (op U)),
      HEq ((mu m 0 ⟨algebraMap A B a, hscalar a⟩).val.app (op U) t)
        ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top (a := U))).op).hom
          (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom a) • t))
    (hfinite : ∀ x : X, ∃ (U : X.Opens), x ∈ U ∧
      ∃ (r : ℕ) (d : Fin r → ℕ) (s : ∀ i : Fin r, (G (d i)).val.obj (op U)),
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U) (t : (G m).val.obj (op V))
          (y : X), y ∈ V → ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V), y ∈ W ∧
            (G m).val.map (homOfLE hWV).op t ∈
              Submodule.span ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op W))
                {z | ∃ (i : Fin r), d i ≤ m ∧
                  ∃ b : graded (m - d i),
                    HEq z ((mu (d i) (m - d i) b).val.app (op W)
                      ((G (d i)).val.map (homOfLE (hWV.trans hVU)).op (s i)))}) :
    let b : Spec (.of B) ⟶ Spec (.of A) := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
    let Y := pullback f b
    let pi := pullback.fst f b
    let C := (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward CommRingCat.{u} pi.base).obj Y.sheaf
    let CR := (sheafCompose _ (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj C
    let rho : X.sheaf ⟶ C := ⟨pi.c⟩
    let S := SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u}
      ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map rho)
    ∃ N : SheafOfModules.{u} CR, N.IsQuasicoherent ∧ N.IsFiniteType ∧
      Nonempty (S.obj N ≅ ∐ G)
